csv_scope_of_work: The City of Bedford is accepting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified firms to establish a list of approved firms to provide professional services as needed. To streamline the evaluation process and reduce the burden on both the City and respondents, this solicitation will be conducted in two phases. During Phase I, firms will submit a concise Statement of Interest summarizing their qualifications, experience, and areas of expertise. Based on the published evaluation criteria, the highest-ranked firms may be invited to participate in Phase II by participating in an interview or presentation and submitting a comprehensive Statement of Qualifications. The City intends to select the most qualified firms for inclusion on its professional services list to support a variety of future projects and services as needs arise
